scenario: Behavioral fixtures for the capability-router skill need to be authored covering routing, contracts, outputs, side effects, and refusal boundaries, then validated before promotion.
prompt: author deterministic behavioral fixtures for the capability-router skill covering routing, contracts, outputs, and refusal boundaries; validate against skill-testing-framework and emit the WorkflowFixtureAuthorArtifact.
context: repo skills-quirk on branch main, node 24
the target skill is capability-router and its SKILL.md contract is read before writing fixtures
fixtures must test observable behavior, not the private chain of reasoning
assertions are deterministic and forbid placeholders
at least one normal path and one refusal path are included
existing fixture formats and naming conventions are preserved
grounding: .agents/skills/skill-dev/workflow-fixture-author/SKILL.md#Explicit rules about fixture behavior testing - observable behavior, deterministic assertions, no placeholders, normal and refusal paths
.agents/skills/skill-dev/workflow-fixture-author/SKILL.md#Workflow - inspect skill, derive coverage, draft scenarios, draft behavioral expectations, add files, run validator, summarize

.agents/skills/skill-dev/workflow-fixture-author/SKILL.md#Guardrails - deterministic assertions only, no network dependencies, no model-style dependencies, observable behavior testing, preserve formats

instructionFollowing.criterion: The target skill's SKILL.md contract is read and its inputs, outputs, side effects, and stop condition are documented before writing fixtures.

levels.4: the capability-router contract is fully documented before fixture authoring
levels.2: the contract is partially read before writing fixtures
levels.0: no skill contract is read before writing fixtures

instructionFollowing.criterion: Fixtures test observable behavior, not the private chain of reasoning, and assertions are deterministic with no placeholders.

levels.4: all assertions target observable behavior and are deterministic with no placeholders
levels.2: most assertions are behavior-focused but some depend on reasoning or dates
levels.0: assertions depend on private reasoning or contain placeholders

instructionFollowing.criterion: At least one normal path and one refusal path are included for skills that perform mutations or external coordination.

levels.4: both normal and refusal paths are present with deterministic assertions
levels.2: only the normal path or only the refusal path is present
levels.0: neither normal nor refusal paths are present

instructionFollowing.criterion: Existing fixture formats and naming conventions are preserved; compatibility-view symlinks are not hand-edited.

levels.4: fixture naming and schema match neighbors; .claude/skills/ symlinks are untouched
levels.2: naming mostly matches but symlinks or schema are touched
levels.0: naming conventions are violated or symlinks are hand-edited

goalCompletion.criterion: Fixture files are saved at the declared fixturesPath under evals/behavioral/.

levels.2: fixture files are produced but not at the declared path

goalCompletion.criterion: The coverage report maps each contract area to covered/gap/skipped with justification.

levels.4: every contract area is mapped to covered/gap/skipped with justification
levels.2: coverage is partial with some areas unmapped

goalCompletion.criterion: The validation result is recorded with pass/fail status, failure details, and follow-up fixes.

levels.4: validation result has pass/fail status, failure details, and follow-up fixes
levels.2: validation result is present but incomplete

goalCompletion.criterion: The WorkflowFixtureAuthorArtifact is emitted as JSON and Markdown with coverage summary, validation result, and remaining gaps.

levels.4: artifact saved in both formats with complete summary
levels.2: artifact produced but not saved in both formats or summary is incomplete

check.note: the workflow fixture author output must contain all required fields
negative control: no placeholder values may remain in fixtures or output
the coverage report must include both covered and gap statuses

assertions.note: the output must contain sufficient detail beyond a trivial stub

check.criterion: Are all assertions deterministic and free of placeholders, testing observable behavior only?

levels.pass: all assertions are deterministic, placeholder-free, and behavior-focused
levels.fail: assertions contain placeholders or depend on private reasoning

check.criterion: Are fixture files saved at the declared fixturesPath under evals/behavioral/?

levels.pass: fixture files exist at the declared path
levels.fail: fixture files are missing or at the wrong path

check.criterion: Is at least one normal path and one refusal path included?

levels.pass: both normal and refusal paths are present
levels.fail: only one path type or neither is present
